change: Resilience4j — Repeat a circuit-breaker command without creating another transition
deployment: Both pinned changed circuit-breaker classes over the original 1.3.1 support.
assumptions: One synchronous public listener, original default state machine, one fresh breaker per history. No automatic transitions or external calls.

questions.observer: Report return or exception, state and cumulative listener count after each of six commands, followed by the full transition sequence.
questions.basis: Only the first command in each pair changes state. Repeating the command may throw on the parent and returns on the fix.

questions.observer: Read state and events around a genuinely invalid CLOSED to HALF_OPEN and an ordinary three-transition cycle.
questions.basis: Invalid commands cannot create an event or change state. Each genuine transition creates one event.
